name: Maggot King

mechanics.name: Standard Attacks
mechanics.description: It attacks with ranged and magic at a speed that keeps changing, and lunges in melee when you are close. The lunge reaches further than it looks like it should.
mechanics.counterplay: Pray against whichever it throws. Fire spells hurt it far more than anything else.

mechanics.name: Screech
mechanics.description: It screeches, and the sound carries across the lair rather than at one target.
mechanics.counterplay: Move as it winds up. Nothing you pray stops this one.

mechanics.name: Ur-maggot Larvae
mechanics.description: Larvae of the parasite that made it crawl out during the fight.
mechanics.counterplay: Clear them before they build up.

_note: SKELETON, NOT LIVE-VERIFIED. Ids come from Jagex's own gameval names rather than guesses, but nothing here has been confirmed in a live fight. Provenance: gamevals from runelite-api 1.12.35 (net.runelite.api.gameval.*), because this cache download ships an empty GAMEVALS index (idx24) and ScanGameVal cannot read it; npc names, models, sequences and extents from the live cache (revision of 2026-08-06). Npc ids: Maggot King 15742 and Maggot King Corpse 15741, both carrying model 61512; the corpse is the lootable state after death and is in npcIds because it is a transform rather than a new spawn (docs/DECISIONS.md D17). Ur-maggot larvae 15743 is an add and detects on npc-spawn. MAGGOT_KING_PET 15740 is excluded. Animations are the MAGGOT_KING_* and NPC_MAGGOT_KING_* sets, all unambiguous gameval names: MELEEATTACK 13925, RANGEATTACK 13933, MAGEATTACK 13934, SCREECH 13922 and IDLE 13926. Projectile MAGGOT_KING_POISON_PROJECTILE 1792 says projectile outright and is curated; VFX_MAGGOT_KING_SCREECH_01 3793 and _02 3794 are graphics and are left out, since a graphic trigger has no source actor to check (D17) and discovery never revokes (D18). Note the two screech VFX ids appear in both the animation space (13923, 13924) and the spotanim space (3793, 3794) under the same names. THE RANGED AND MAGIC ATTACKS SHARE ONE MECHANIC despite having separate animations, because the wiki treats the opening of the fight as a single job, using both while melee is locked out; splitting them is followup 3 and would be a fair improvement. THE MELEE LOCKOUT DETECTS ON THE BOSS'S OWN npc-spawn, so it unlocks on arrival rather than at the health threshold where melee starts working. That is deliberate: it is the single most important thing to know before the fight starts, so unlocking it early is right, and there is no trigger for a health threshold in any case. A requires gate on a varp would be the honest way to tie it to the threshold if one exists (docs/DECISIONS.md D38), the way Doom's delve level went. THIS BOSS'S ANIMATIONS ARE SKELETAL, SO THE PREVIEW VALUES ARE AN ESTIMATE, NOT ARITHMETIC (docs/DECISIONS.md D36). FitZoom returned empty extents for all three sequences tried. The values follow the method Doom of Mokhaiotl already ships under: take the zoom from struct 1188, the Combat Achievements screen's own entry, which pins model 61512 at zoom 2600, and compute shiftY from the bind pose extents at that zoom. The larvae fitted normally at zoom 165, the smallest in the plugin. staticFallback is false on all five; whether each body animation reads has not been eyeballed in game, and for a skeletal boss that check matters more than usual. The collection log page is titled 'Maggot King', matching 'name'. FEEDBACK PASS 2026-08-07 (Andrew reviewed every boss in game): "Melee Lockout" is dropped, and "Ranged and Magic" plus "Melee Lunge" are collapsed into one "Standard Attacks". The merged row carries the union of every source row's triggers, so a player who witnesses any of the old attacks still discovers it; the old mechanic ids simply stop matching inside an existing discovered CSV, which docs/DECISIONS.md D18 makes safe without a migration. It keeps the first source row's preview verbatim, since every source already shared a model.
